nodes.label: lake-greek.jpg mockup photo
nodes.description: Landscape-orientation (3:2) daytime travel photograph used as a mockup/seed photo fixture (MOCKUP_PHOTOS_DIR) for media, inline image and card rendering in the Notes Archive e2e and demo data. No text, no UI.

nodes.label: Mountain lake valley viewed through conifers
nodes.description: Elevated viewpoint over a small blue lake with a wooded island/peninsula, set in a forested valley below a rounded hill, with a hazy multi-peak mountain range and clear blue sky behind; foreground framed by a dead bare tree on the left and green pines/firs on the right. Wide tonal range (deep greens, pale blue sky) useful for testing image cropping, thumbnails and frosted-glass overlays.

nodes.label: Greek mountain lake (possibly Lake Doxa, Peloponnese)
nodes.description: Location implied by the filename 'lake-greek'; the lake shape with a small chapel island/peninsula and fir forest resembles Lake Doxa near Mount Ziria in Corinthia, but this identification is a visual guess.
